## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall boy with curly brown hair and roguish hazel eyes. His mouth is often twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

## Personality

Gilbert is a clever, ambitious, and good-natured young man who exhibits a kind and thoughtful demeanor alongside a tendency to tease the girls. Driven by determination, he aims to earn his own way through college and get the most out of life.

## History

Gilbert Blythe spent three years in Alberta caring for his sick father and a summer visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick) before returning to school. Upon his return, he teased [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) by calling her 'Carrots,' which resulted in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashing her slate over his head and refusing his apology. This sparked an intense academic rivalry between the two students, though Gilbert rescued [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when her boat began to leak and offered his friendship, which she angrily rejected. Their fierce competition continued through their time in the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) class and later at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Gilbert won the academic medal while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) won the Avery Scholarship. Upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) intended to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after Matthew's death and Marilla's failing eyesight, Gilbert selflessly gave up his position as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could take the post close to home, leading them to finally reconcile their long-standing feud and become close friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."

> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert's relationship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins antagonistically after he teases her by calling her 'Carrots', leading to an ongoing grudge where she repeatedly rejects his apologies and offers of friendship, even after he rescues her from a leaking boat. Despite her lingering public hostility, Gilbert harbors romantic feelings for her while competing fiercely against her for the top marks in school. Over time, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly forgives him and uses his presence as motivation, though a stubborn distance remains between them.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +27 more_

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is a friend to Gilbert who acts as a peacemaker in his ongoing feud with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Though [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) remains Anne's closest companion, Gilbert's prominent presence as an academic rival and classmate makes him a constant subject of discussion and shared experiences between the two girls.

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert shares an academic rivalry with [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) throughout their schooling. Their competition culminates at graduation, where Gilbert wins the school medal while [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) secures the Avery Scholarship.
